title: Tavern Brawl
summary: Shoot bottles, plates, and mugs out of the air while the balcony crowd cheers. Break 20 targets to face the outlaw on Main Street, where three well-timed countershots win the duel.
summaryZhTW: 在酒館樓上的歡呼聲中，擊碎飛過頭頂的酒瓶、盤子和杯子。打中 20 個目標後，走上大街與歹徒決鬥，抓準空檔回擊三次就能勝出。
coverAlt: Under the title Tavern Brawl, a sheriff shatters a flying plate while balcony spectators cheer. An outlaw waits beyond the swinging doors.
controls: Move with the left and right arrows or A/D. Press Space to fire and P or Escape to pause. Touch controls are available on screen.

approval.note: Creator approved game deployment and the Possibility Games catalog addition.
